name: hover-border-gradient
title: Hover Border Gradient
description: A rounded call-to-action button wrapped in a blurred gradient border. The glow creeps around the edge on a timer and washes blue when hovered.
use: A dark page needs one hero call to action that draws the eye with a moving rim of light.
avoid: The glow is faint against black and the body is hardcoded black, so it does not suit light themes.
a11y: The travelling glow is decorative but runs on a timer and ignores reduced-motion; focusing the button does not light the rim. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black pill button holding a small white chevron and the label, wrapped in a soft glowing rim. The rim is brightest at one segment and fades around the rest, and turns blue across most of its length on hover.
behaves: At rest the brightest part of the rim steps from side to side every second, chasing around the pill. Hovering blends the whole rim into a blue highlight, then the slow white sweep resumes when the pointer leaves.
customise: Pick the rendered element with as, set sweep speed with duration and its direction with clockwise, and restyle inside and rim with className and containerClassName. The highlight blue is fixed.
weight: light: One animated gradient layer with a blur; negligible DOM.
